pt.name: Caio Barbieri
pt.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) | Cloud & Platform Engineering
pt.about: Profissional de SRE / Cloud com mais de 4 anos de experiência em DevOps, Kubernetes e automação de infraestrutura. Atuação em plataformas AWS, GitOps e ferramentas para desenvolvedores, com experiência prática em observabilidade, segurança em nuvem e resposta a incidentes em ambientes de clientes. Certificações AWS Security - Specialty e Solutions Architect - Associate.
headline: Plataformas confiáveis na nuvem
e as ferramentas para operá-las.
pt.intro: SRE sênior com foco em cloud e engenharia de plataforma, hoje na Opsteam. Cuido de plataformas AWS e Kubernetes, GitOps, observabilidade, segurança em nuvem e resposta a incidentes — e publico ferramentas open source para quem opera sistemas e agentes de IA.

focus.title: Plataforma & Kubernetes
focus.description: Fundações AWS com Terraform e EKS, upgrades de clusters com Karpenter e módulos, Helm charts e templates Backstage reutilizáveis.

focus.title: GitOps & CI/CD
focus.description: Fluxos com Argo CD, GitHub Actions e GitLab CI — incluindo a migração de GitLab self-hosted e runners para o Amazon EKS.

focus.title: Observabilidade
focus.description: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, VictoriaMetrics, CloudWatch e Alertmanager: logs centralizados entre regiões, dashboards e alertas refinados.

focus.title: Segurança & incidentes
focus.description: IAM de menor privilégio, OIDC e SSO, Keycloak e Vault, segmentação de rede e resposta a incidentes com preservação de evidências.

en.name: Caio Barbieri
en.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) | Cloud & Platform Engineering
en.about: SRE / Cloud professional with 4+ years of experience in DevOps, Kubernetes and infrastructure automation. Works across AWS platforms, GitOps and developer tooling, with hands-on experience in observability, cloud security and incident response in client environments. AWS Certified Security – Specialty and Solutions Architect – Associate.
headline: Reliable cloud platforms
and the tools to run them.
en.intro: Senior SRE focused on cloud and platform engineering, currently at Opsteam. I run AWS and Kubernetes platforms, GitOps, observability, cloud security and incident response — and I publish open-source tools for people who run systems and AI agents.

focus.title: Platform & Kubernetes
focus.description: AWS foundations with Terraform and EKS, cluster upgrades with Karpenter, and reusable modules, Helm charts and Backstage templates.

focus.title: GitOps & CI/CD
focus.description: Delivery flows with Argo CD, GitHub Actions and GitLab CI — including moving self-hosted GitLab and its runners to Amazon EKS.

focus.title: Observability
focus.description: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, VictoriaMetrics, CloudWatch and Alertmanager: cross-region log centralization, dashboards and tuned alerts.

focus.title: Security & incidents
focus.description: Least-privilege IAM, OIDC and SSO, Keycloak and Vault, network segmentation and incident response with evidence preservation.
